title: Spacetime Engine
text: Follow the model layout; individual block facings do not matter. Build the model with four Infused Crystal Casings, four Mana Engines, one Enhanced Alchemical Energy Core and one Spacetime Spell Core. Empty the engines and activate the spell core with one Infused Crystal. It cannot be mined; carry it with a Pocket Magic Bottle.

No fuel or redstone is needed. Output is on by default; the UI switch controls all four independent pulse sources. Connect through Arcane Dust or Spacetime Ports. Stress conversion is clockwise at 16 rpm; use Create mechanisms to reverse it.
Configure potential for each face, up to 2048 MPU before grid multipliers. Front, right, rear and left use blue, gold, purple and green, matching the screen.
The three grid multipliers multiply: Basic x1.2, Elemental x1.5, Arcane x2 and Omni x4, increasing each face's potential limit. Grids float horizontally on the rotating array.
Native pulse output keeps shafts still while the array rotates slowly. See Magic Pulses for external conversion rules.
